plate_masters.name: Full Heal
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. Remove all special conditions from that Pokémon. (This excludes Wait.)

plate_masters.name: Bright Powder
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. For this turn, you can make any battle opponent of this Pokémon spin again once.

plate_masters.name: Rare Candy
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field to evolve. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Invisibility Cape
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the bench. For this turn, it can move through other Pokémon when making an MP move.

plate_masters.name: X Speed
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, one of this Pokémon's White Attacks will be changed to a Gold Attack before battle.

plate_masters.name: X Sp. Atk
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, it has ★+2.

plate_masters.name: Swap Spot
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. Switch it with another of your Pokémon that it is next to.

plate_masters.name: Focus Band
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, it cannot be knocked out.

plate_masters.name: Double Chance
plate_masters.description: Choose a Pokémon on the field or bench. (You cannot select unusable Pokémon) For this turn, you can choose to respin once for it.

plate_masters.name: X Defend
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, if its opponent deals 10-100 damage in battle, this Pokémon will not be knocked out.

plate_masters.name: Clear Wait
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. Remove Wait from that Pokémon.

plate_masters.name: No Guard
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, if that Pokémon or its battle opponent spins a Blue Attack, shift the spin one segment clockwise.

plate_masters.name: Power Battle
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, if that Pokémon or its battle opponent spins a Purple Attack, shift the spin one segment clockwise.

plate_masters.name: X Attack
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, it deals +30 damage.

plate_masters.name: Pokémon Switch
plate_masters.description: Choose two of your Pokémon on the field or bench and switch their positions. Your turn ends. (You cannot select two Pokémon from the bench.)

plate_masters.name: Scoop Up
plate_masters.description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. Return it to the bench.

plate_masters.name: Recycle
plate_masters.description: All Plates from both players except Recycle become usable. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Long Throw
plate_masters.description: Move one Pokémon from your bench to one space away from your entry point. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Max Revive
plate_masters.description: Select one of your Pokémon in your P.C. That Pokémon moves to the bench. (That Pokémon cannot have Wait.)

plate_masters.name: Dread Power

plate_masters.name: Iron Power

plate_masters.name: Desperate Times

plate_masters.name: Priority Recovery
plate_masters.description: Switch the order of your Pokémon in your P.C. You cannot use this plate unless you have two or more of your Pokémon in your P.C. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Quick Care

plate_masters.name: Switcheroo

plate_masters.name: X Accuracy

Also, if the Fainted opposing Pokémon is a Grass-type, Ice-type, Bug-type, or Steel-type, the opponent will be removed from the duel.

plate_masters.name: Land's Energy

plate_masters.name: Long Barrel

plate_masters.description: Select one of your Grass-type Pokémon on the field. While that Pokémon is on the field, the battle opponents of that Pokémon cannot respin. Spin-again effects are treated as single spins only.

plate_masters.name: Tropical Energy
plate_masters.description: Any special conditions are removed from your Grass-, Flying-, and Bug-type Pokémon. During this duel, the effects of Abilities that allow you or your opponent to respin or force respins in battle are nullified for the battle opponents of your Grass-, Flying-, and Bug-type Pokémon. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Dark Energy
plate_masters.description: During this duel, if the opponent Pokémon is a Psychic type, your Dark-type Pokémon are not knocked out in battle, but are moved to the bench and gain Wait instead. And when you have two or more Dark-type Pokémon on the field, Energy effects on your opponent's Psychic- and Ghost-type Pokémon are nullified. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Phantom Energy
plate_masters.description: During this duel, your Ghost-type Pokémon can move over Pokémon affected by special conditions when using an MP move. In addition, when one or more of your Ghost-type Pokémon surround an opposing Pokémon, if there are three or more opposing Pokémon on the field or on your oppontent’s bench with the same name as the surrounded Pokémon, remove the surrounded Pokémon from the game. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Flame Energy
plate_masters.description: Your opponent’s burned Pokémon gain Wait 3. During this duel, your Fire-type Pokémon cannot be frozen or burned. Your turn ends.

plate_masters.name: Steel Energy

plate_masters.name: Poison Blade
